description.value: MoMA Design Store - 53rd Street is at 44 West 53rd Street, New York 10019 Across from the Museum, between 5th and 6th Avenues. The store says This destination store offers the best selection of new and classic design objects and gifts for everyone, and its light, airy space covers lighting, tech, tabletop, home decor and jewelry. A Tripadvisor reviewer (search snapshot) notes that, Spread across two floors, there's plenty to explore. Every Friday, the store will remain open until 9:00 p.m., which makes it an easy add-on after a museum evening. Tripadvisor shows 4.4 of 5 bubbles (636 reviews) in a search snapshot. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “The MoMA Design Store is packed with beautifully designed products”. Representative watch-outs: “The store can get quite crowded around midday” and “Prices are better on the internet than in the store.”
